pr_title: [wasm][debugger] Fix loading a non wasm page and then returning to a wasm page.
pr_body:
It was creating a new store, but it was not creating a new SdbHelper nor cleaning the cache, now when I set the store on SdbHelper I clear the cache.
Also don't throw an exception when have an error while trying to call the debugger functions (as it was done before moving to use debugger-agent).

I think we can open a PR to servicing, or maybe to 6.0? I don't think it's too risky.
Fixes #60613

review_comments:
How does this work? When will the command return an error? And when it does, we return an "empty reader", and the caller will fail to read from it (like in `GetMethodToken`) ?

Also, is the same change needed for `SendDebuggerAgentCommandWithParmsInternal` too?

We only would send these commands for a "non-wasm-page" by mistake:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4503299/138137287-c997312a-14d9-4c27-b334-9f89a45ce5fb.png)
They don't need answer.

A command may return an error in a case where is a wasm page, for example, when we ask for information of an assembly with id -1, and -1 doesn't exist, this would return an error.

I want to do more changes to handle errors, for example, set a flag on MonoBinaryReader when an error is returned and receive the error message. But I don't want to backport it to net6.0, that is why I didn't do in this PR.
I changed `SendDebuggerAgentCommandWithParmsInternal `, but for this case it doesn't matter, it will not be called in a non-wasm-page.

Should the same thing be done for `valueTypes`, and `pointerValues` too?

Maybe rename the method to `ResetStore`, and call it from the .ctor as `ResetStore(null)`.
And remove the field initializers, and only initialize them in this method, so we have a lesser chance of missing any new ones that get added.
